title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 236 Concord Exchange North in South Saint Paul, Minnesota, as the "Officer Leo Pavlak Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 236 Concord Exchange North in South Saint Paul, Minnesota, as the Officer Leo Pavlak Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a South Saint Paul, Minnesota post office building after Officer Leo Pavlak.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 236 Concord Exchange North in South Saint Paul, Minnesota, as the Officer Leo Pavlak Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or any rules for mail. It is an honorary designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
